description_en: Calls DescribeACLAttribute to query the information about a specified access control list (ACL) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeACLAttribute查询指定访问控制实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-acl-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-ohlexqptfhyaq0000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --direction out --order 1255444444 --name doctest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeACLAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the access control list (ACL) instance
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control list (ACL) instance
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of access control rule entries to display per page in a paginated query.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页展示的访问控制规则条目数。

取值范围：1~50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paginated query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the access control rule. Valid values:

in: inbound. Refers to traffic from external sources accessing the local branch where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed.
out: outbound. Refers to traffic from the local branch where the SAG instance is deployed accessing external destinations
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则应用方向。取值：

in：入方向，指从外部访问智能接入网关实例所在的本地分支的流量。
out：出方向，指从智能接入网关实例所在的本地分支访问外部的流量
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The name of the ACL instance.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
This parameter supports fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例名称。

长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
该参数支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: name

Acr.description_en: The access control rule information in the current ACL instance
Acr.description_zh: 当前访问控制实例包含的访问控制规则信息

AclType.description_en:
The type of SAG instance that the ACL instance supports binding to. Valid values:

acl-hardware: SAG hardware instance.
acl-software: SAG App instance
AclType.description_zh:
访问控制实例支持绑定的智能接入网关实例类型。取值：

acl-hardware：智能接入网关硬件实例。
acl-software：智能接入网关App实例

Description.description_en:
The description of the access control rule.

The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length.

This field is not returned by default. You can set it by calling the ModifyACLRule operation. After the description is set, it is returned in query results
Description.description_zh:
访问控制规则描述信息。

描述长度为1~512个字符。

此字段默认不会返回。可通过ModifyACLRule接口设置，设置后查询会正常返回

DestCidr.description_en:
The destination CIDR block.

The destination CIDR block is in CIDR notation. Example: 192.168.10.0/24
DestCidr.description_zh:
目的网段。

目的网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.10.0/24

DestPortRange.description_en:
The destination port range.

Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Examples of destination port range format: 1/200, 80/80. The value -1/-1 indicates that no port restriction is applied
DestPortRange.description_zh:
目的端口范围。

取值范围：-1或1~65535。

目的端口范围格式例如：1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1代表不限制端口

Direction.description_en:
The direction of the access control rule.

in: inbound. Refers to traffic from external sources accessing the local branch where the SAG instance is deployed.
out: outbound. Refers to traffic from the local branch where the SAG instance is deployed accessing external destinations
Direction.description_zh:
访问控制规则应用方向。

in：入方向，指从外部访问智能接入网关实例所在的本地分支的流量。
out：出方向，指从智能接入网关实例所在的本地分支访问外部的流量

items.description_en:
The list of application group IDs matched by the current access control rule.

You can call [ListDpiGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html） to query application group IDs and the application information they contain
items.description_zh:
当前访问控制规则匹配的应用组ID列表。

您可以通过[ListDpiGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html）查询应用组ID及其包含的应用信息

items.description_en:
The list of application IDs matched by the current access control rule.

You can call [ListDpiSignatures]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html） to query application IDs and their corresponding application information
items.description_zh:
当前访问控制规则匹配的应用ID列表。

您可以通过[ListDpiSignatures]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html）查询应用ID及其对应的应用信息

GmtCreate.description_en:
The timestamp when the access control rule was created.

The timestamp is in the Long format. When priorities are the same, the access control rule with the smaller timestamp takes effect first
GmtCreate.description_zh:
创建访问控制规则时的时间戳。

时间戳格式为Long型，优先级相同时，时间戳小的访问控制规则优先生效

IpProtocol.description_en:
The protocol used by the access control rule.

For the protocol types supported by the access control feature, refer to the console. The protocol format is case-insensitive
IpProtocol.description_zh:
访问控制规则应用的协议。

访问控制功能支持的协议类型，请以控制台为准。协议格式不区分大小写

Name.description_en:
The name of the ACL instance.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
Name.description_zh:
访问控制实例名称。

长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

Policy.description_en:
The authorization policy of the access control rule:

accept: allows traffic.

drop: denies traffic
Policy.description_zh:
访问控制规则授权策略：

accept：允许。

drop：拒绝

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the access control rule.

Valid values: 1 to 100
Priority.description_zh:
访问控制规则优先级。

取值范围：1~100

SourceCidr.description_en:
The source CIDR block.

The source CIDR block is in CIDR notation. Example: 192.168.1.0/24
SourceCidr.description_zh:
源网段。

源网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.1.0/24

SourcePortRange.description_en:
The source port range.

Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Examples of source port range format: 1/200, 80/80. The value -1/-1 indicates that no port restriction is applied
SourcePortRange.description_zh:
源端口范围。

取值范围：-1或1~65535。

源端口范围格式例如：1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1代表不限制端口

Type.description_en:
The type of the access control rule:

LAN: private network. Indicates that access control rules are configured for traffic destined for private IP addresses.

WAN: public network. Indicates that access control rules are configured for traffic destined for public IP addresses
Type.description_zh:
访问控制规则类型：

LAN：私网，表示针对私网地址的流量设置访问控制规则。

WAN：公网，表示针对公网地址的流量设置访问控制规则

PageNumber.description_en: The page number in a paginated query

PageSize.description_en: The number of access control rule entries displayed per page in a paginated query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页展示的访问控制规则条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of access control rule entries in the current ACL instance
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前访问控制实例包含的总的访问控制规则条目数
